description: What the refresh suite must notice: the Hub may be aimed at another host, or sends more than it should (a credential, a header, a redirect followed), reads without a size or time limit, takes a damaged, edited, older or future file for its list, forgets to say why, keeps a stale list in use, loses a refresh's result, makes two requests for two refreshes, or the routes answer more than they should.

mutations.name: R1
mutations.what: any host is accepted as the source of the list

patches.old: throw coded('catalog_source_refused', `The model catalog is read from ${SOURCE_URL} only (or from a loopback address); ${url.host} is refused.`);

mutations.name: R2
mutations.what: a login, a query or a fragment in the address is accepted

patches.old: if (url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash) throw coded('catalog_source_refused', 'The model catalog address must not carry a login, a query or a fragment.');

mutations.name: R3
mutations.what: a redirect is followed

mutations.name: R4
mutations.what: credentials of the browser kind are sent with the request

mutations.name: R5
mutations.what: the request carries a header besides what the answer is asked to be

mutations.name: R6
mutations.what: a size the answer declares over the limit is not noticed

mutations.name: R7
mutations.what: the limit on a streamed body is a thousand times too generous

mutations.name: R8
mutations.what: a time out is reported as a network error

mutations.name: R9
mutations.what: a price tier of the wrong length passes the check of a snapshot

mutations.name: R10
mutations.what: a provider that names a row that does not exist passes the check of a snapshot

mutations.name: S1
mutations.what: the hash of a file in the data folder is not checked (an edited file is used)

patches.old: if (!snapshotIsIntact(snapshot)) throw new Error('Its hash does not match its content.');

mutations.name: S2
mutations.what: a file older than the list that ships with the Hub is used

mutations.name: S3
mutations.what: a file dated in the future is used

mutations.name: S4
mutations.what: a start that cannot use the file leaves the list that was in use before it in use

mutations.name: S5
mutations.what: a failed refresh is recorded as a success

mutations.name: S6
mutations.what: two refreshes at once make two requests

mutations.name: S7
mutations.what: a refresh writes the file but the list in use does not change

mutations.name: S8
mutations.what: a document that is not the catalog is written anyway

patches.old: throw Object.assign(new Error(String(error?.message ?? 'The answer is not the catalog.')), { code: 'catalog_unusable', statusCode: 502 });

mutations.name: H1
mutations.what: an alias is reported as trusted by model-info

mutations.name: H2
mutations.what: the limit of the list of models is not passed on

patches.old: const list = models({ presetId, apiBaseUrl }, { limit, accept: (id) => MODEL_ID.test(id) });
patches.new: const list = models({ presetId, apiBaseUrl }, { accept: (id) => MODEL_ID.test(id) });

mutations.name: H3
mutations.what: a limit of 0 is accepted for the list of models

mutations.name: H4
mutations.what: a limit above 500 is accepted for the list of models

mutations.name: H5
mutations.what: the refresh route answers without refreshing

mutations.name: H6
mutations.what: the list of models is asked for without a preset or an endpoint

patches.old: if (!presetId && !apiBaseUrl) throw invalid('give a preset or an apiBaseUrl.', code);

mutations.name: N1
mutations.what: the Hub fetches the list when it starts

mutations.name: N2
mutations.what: reading the status of the list is enough to make the Hub download one

mutations.name: N3
mutations.what: a GET route of the list downloads a newer one first

patches.old: url.pathname === '/api/ai/catalog') { await catalogReady; return json(200, catalogs.status()); }
patches.new: url.pathname === '/api/ai/catalog') { await catalogReady; await catalogs.refresh().catch(() => {}); return json(200, catalogs.status()); }

mutations.name: C1
mutations.what: a refresh is made on a machine whose clock is before the date of the list that ships

mutations.name: C2
mutations.what: the list is replaced while a task is running

patches.old: case '/api/ai/catalog/refresh': requireNoTask('Chờ các tác vụ AI đang chạy xong rồi mới cập nhật danh sách model: mỗi lượt chạy giữ nguyên kế hoạch và giá của nó.'); await catalogReady;

mutations.name: C3
mutations.what: a provider with any name is built into the snapshot (a provider called __proto__ becomes the prototype of the others)

mutations.name: C4
mutations.what: a model id with a line break, a space or a hundred and fifty characters too many is built into the snapshot

mutations.name: C5
mutations.what: a saved file with an id that has a line break in it is used

patches.old: if (!MODEL_ID_OK.test(modelId)) bad(`provider ${shown(providerId)} has a model called ${shown(modelId)}`);

mutations.name: C6
mutations.what: a tier of half a token is stored as a tier of none, which no snapshot can be read with

patches.old: if (!Number.isFinite(whole) || whole <= 0 || input === null || output === null) return;
patches.new: if (!Number.isFinite(whole) || input === null || output === null) return;

mutations.name: C7
mutations.what: the spelling of an id of any length is worked on (one id of 192,000 characters holds the Hub for seconds, a longer one for minutes)

mutations.name: C8
mutations.what: a date that does not exist (2026-13-45) is a date

mutations.name: C9
mutations.what: a message that quotes the document quotes all of it, line breaks included

mutations.name: C10
mutations.what: the list of a provider's models offers ids the Hub refuses to save

mutations.name: C11
mutations.what: a canonical id with a line break is built into the snapshot
